  "pros": [
    "Keeps all project communication and files in one central place",
    "Simple and intuitive interface for managing personal projects",
    "Flat-rate pricing is excellent value for a self-employed individual"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Can feel a bit overwhelming with many active projects",
    "Search functionality for old items could be improved",
    "Lacks advanced features like complex task dependencies"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "As a self-employed owner, this user found Basecamp to be a highly effective tool for managing their projects over several years. They appreciated its straightforward approach to keeping tasks, discussions, and files organized without unnecessary complexity. While the platform occasionally felt cluttered with numerous projects, and they desired better search capabilities for historical data, its overall simplicity and value for money made it a solid choice for their needs."
